info.title: DiagramGenerator CLI
info.description: Command-line tool for DiagramGenerator - turns T-SQL stored procedures into navigable Mermaid flow diagrams via the hosted API.

options.name: --output
options.description:
Directory to write generated diagrams to.
Defaults to the current directory

options.name: --recursive
options.description:
True       Search subdirectories when an input path is a
directory

options.name: --format
options.description:
Mermaid    Output format: mermaid (default, raw .mmd
text) or json (includes the full graph)

options.name: --key
options.description:
Your API key. Falls back to the
BNL_DIAGRAMS_API_KEY environment variable
